HEADLINE: Your Promo Code Field May Be Sending Revenue To Affiliates via @sejournal, @lorenbaker

blog.headline: How Your Promo Code Field Is Quietly Bleeding Revenue to Affiliates
blog.angle: Ecommerce sites want every sale but handing off promo code searches to affiliates creates tension between capturing revenue and paying unnecessary commissions; the fix is owning the promo code experience to stop revenue leakage.

linkedin.headline: Every time a shopper leaves your checkout to find a promo code, you’re paying a commission for a sale you already had.
linkedin.angle: Promo code fields that drive customers to affiliate sites create hidden revenue loss, forcing founders to rethink their checkout UX to protect margins.

facebook.headline: Is your promo code field sending money straight to affiliates?
facebook.angle: Ecommerce businesses risk losing revenue when customers use promo code fields to hunt discounts and end up on affiliate sites—how much are you paying out for sales you already had?

instagram.headline: Stop Losing Revenue to Promo Code Affiliates
instagram.angle: When your promo code field sends shoppers to affiliates, you’re outsourcing part of your customer experience and paying unnecessary commissions.
